situation: Input costs and delivery effort have increased, but the owner fears losing long-standing regular customers if prices change.
owner_request: Tell me whether to raise prices next month and how to do it safely.
constraints: The shop does not know profitability by service type.
The owner can test a change on selected services before a full revision.
acceptable_characteristics: Requests or calculates service-level economics before choosing the final increase.
Separates cost recovery from an arbitrary across-the-board percentage.
Proposes a staged change and clear customer communication.
Considers rework reduction and service packaging alongside price.
harmful_responses: Promises that regular customers will stay.
Recommends no change solely to avoid discomfort.

ground_truth_sources.supports: Timing, input-cost change, customer concentration, rework, and missing service margins are the decision facts.
